statement.text: SELECT "c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5" FROM (SELECT "c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5" FROM (SELECT "ORDER_ID" AS "c1", "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "c2", "AMOUNT" AS "c3", "CHANNEL" AS "c4", "UPDATED_AT" AS "c5" FROM "dbo.orders") AS "t2" WHERE ("c3" > @p0)) AS "t1" ORDER BY CASE WHEN "c1" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "c1" ASC LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p2
